crystalline_obstruction.conclusion: Q0 cannot be the full Frobenius determinant in this fixed-normalization class

crystalline_obstruction.dichotomy: after undoing a fixed Tate twist p^w, the full determinant mod p is everywhere a unit when w=0 and identically zero when w>0

exact_determinant_divisor.classification: the already forced Item360 transverse divisor, not a new independent Frobenius divisor

lisse_obstruction.actual_witness: (h,s,p)=(10,11,109) has Q0=0, hence the literal companion is singular
lisse_obstruction.conclusion: the literal companion cannot be Frobenius of a lisse mod-p system on a good locus containing all actual rows
lisse_obstruction.removing_zero_divisor_issue: deleting Q0=0 from the lisse locus removes exactly the rows whose density must be bounded
lisse_obstruction.statement: Frobenius on a lisse rank-two mod-p fiber lies in GL_2, so its determinant is nonzero at every unramified point

literal_support_obstruction.Artin_Schreier_conclusion: the literal reduced polynomial pullback has Swan conductor 2(p-1) at infinity
literal_support_obstruction.Artin_Schreier_degree: deg L_p(z^2)=2(p-1), which is not divisible by p
literal_support_obstruction.Kummer_conclusion: literal full-order Kummer realization has linearly growing conductor support
literal_support_obstruction.finite_log: L_p(z^2) has at least p-2 distinct roots
literal_support_obstruction.not_ruled_out: a different unipotent, Artin-Schreier-Witt, or cohomological compression with proved bounded conductor
literal_support_obstruction.ramification: multiplicities one or two are nonzero modulo p-1 and p^2-1 for p>=13

pointwise_product_obstruction.scope: pointwise local factors whose determinants depend separately on local contributions; target-global factors evade the theorem only by abandoning locality
pointwise_product_obstruction.universal_separability_test: (x+y)(x+y)_xy-(x+y)_x(x+y)_y=-1, but the same operator is zero on f(x)g(y)
pointwise_product_obstruction.zero_locus: a product determinant vanishes through at least one local factor, whereas Q0 is a selected additive cancellation

symbolic_theorem.conclusion: a universal pointwise product of local determinant factors cannot equal the additive transverse selector once two local contributions vary independently
